## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: aca auth status --json lists substack and x sessions with saved_at,...

The system SHALL ensure that aca auth status --json lists substack and x sessions with saved_at, last_verified_at, and refresh_command fields.

#### Scenario: aca auth status --json lists substack and x sessions with saved_at,...

WHEN `add-browser-session-rows-to-aca-auth-status` is implemented
THEN aca auth status --json lists substack and x sessions with saved_at, last_verified_at, and refresh_command fields.

### Requirement: Stdout contains exactly one JSON document in --json mode with diagnostics on...

The system SHALL ensure that stdout contains exactly one JSON document in --json mode with diagnostics on stderr.

#### Scenario: Stdout contains exactly one JSON document in --json mode with diagnostics on...

WHEN `add-browser-session-rows-to-aca-auth-status` is implemented
THEN Stdout contains exactly one JSON document in --json mode with diagnostics on stderr.

### Requirement: No cookie value appears in either output mode

The system SHALL ensure that no cookie value appears in either output mode.

#### Scenario: No cookie value appears in either output mode

WHEN `add-browser-session-rows-to-aca-auth-status` is implemented
THEN No cookie value appears in either output mode.
